historical_result.preceding_snapshot: The Orders page snapshot included a Filters button, but the visible locator could not match it. That snapshot showed an inherited Suspected Fraud filter and zero records.

paired_site_diagnostic.input: The same 14 frozen actions and the same 308-record Orders page before action 7 on two diagnostic builds from the b47fab8b source family.

baseline.visual_observation: The navigation sidebar rendered, while the Orders content area was blank despite the Filters button appearing in the DOM snapshot.

combined_fix.visual_observation: The Orders content and Filters control rendered, and the trajectory reached the filtered order table.

paired_site_diagnostic.source_binding_limit: The two diagnostic receipts identify binaries and identical action bindings but do not retain a complete source diff between those binaries. The combined change cannot be attributed to only one component.

identified_shared_input_defect.mechanism: A separate continuation showed that filling the end-date input can leave Knockout's filter value empty until blur. Applying immediately can omit the upper date bound. This input defect is separate from the historical Filters-button timeout and was observed in both browser routes; an explicit Tab/blur corrected the qualified candidate.
identified_shared_input_defect.current_candidate_result: The revised candidate with explicit blur passed the official task evaluator and its monthly counts matched independent store-timezone database counts 12, 7, 5, 9, 5.

source_mechanisms.mechanism: Exact geometry queries must not reuse a frozen layout tree after dynamic layout inputs change.
The computed root style must synchronize the device state used to resolve rem and root line-height units.

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 历史轨迹中 Filters 按钮已在 DOM 快照，但可见点击超时。用正式评测相同的 Moli 1.1.3 镜像重放原动作，60 秒后订单网格已在 DOM、页面加载完成，两枚 Filters 按钮及父容器仍全为零矩形，offsetParent 为 null；同页 Clear all 和订单链接也为零矩形。因此失败属于旧版订单网格几何不可用，不是按钮或数据缺失，与 #196/#204 同族。早期同输入组合修复从 6/14 变为 14/14 并通过官方验收，固定候选也完成原始 14 步；但布局脏快照刷新与根字号 rem 同步的单项贡献没有二分。日期输入缺少失焦会漏掉结束日期，是另一个已修正的轨迹输入问题。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: The historical Filters button appeared in the DOM snapshot, yet the visible click timed out. Replaying the original actions on the same Moli 1.1.3 image as the formal evaluation, the order grid was in the DOM and the document was complete after 60 seconds, but both Filters buttons and their parents still had zero rectangles and null offsetParent; Clear all and order links on the same page were also zero-area. This is the same old-version order-grid geometry defect family as tasks 196 and 204, not a missing button or data. An earlier same-input combined fix changed 6/14 actions to 14/14 and passed the official evaluator; the fixed candidate also completed all original actions. The individual contributions of dirty-layout refresh versus root rem-state synchronization were not bisected. A missing end-date blur is a separate corrected trajectory-input defect.

scope_limit: The same formal Moli image reproduces the observable geometry defect. The audit does not isolate one source change, replace the immutable historical score or certify a new fixed-version cohort.
